asr.full_text: Come and lift your glasses for the new Madi... Presses Enik! Surprise! I know you worry about things changing Nothing is going to change! Absolutely nothing is going to change! You are Enik's new woman? I'm a new woman I'm a new girl Me too I'm amazed by the news that my best friend has made a huge mistake You are making us a terrible nerve attack! You're not a road safety! Of course you are! The results do not match all our expectations. Do you plan to show up at the pool without telling your family? I know how they're gonna take her! Coyote will be in complete panic, Bud will cry, and just like in your worst nightmare, Frankie will settle in our house. I know how they're gonna take him. Coyote completely panicked and Bud cried. Like in your nightmares, Frankie is coming after us. Surprise! Plan change. COLLIDE I haven't made a spark in a husband's arm long time. 1, 2, 3! Honey, everything clear? Absolutely fine, darling. If you can't speak to your husband, you have to think about your first wedding! It's one thing I've always wanted to think of. It reminds us of a new obstacle in life we have to cross paths with. New business for us both. The toilet is in the stands stands still. The crowd's going crazy! Since we became friends, we've done so many crazy things. Don't resist, Grace. Let our brutes do their job. But we've always done them with spirit. This is our second product. Your luck goes to both of you! I think we better better if we try to quit moping Yeah! Let's go fishing for a big shark! Let's go! Yeah! Good evening, sharks!
